title: ModuleInventory
description: Unified Community + Enterprise module inventory (feature 012, plan addendum B3). Built from acquired snapshots by static ast.literal_eval of __manifest__.py; nothing is executed. Keys of 'modules' are module names matching ^[a-z0-9_]{1,64}$; that key rule cannot be expressed in the stdlib checker subset, so verify_inventory enforces it together with the record shape in $defs.module. A module present in more than one source is never resolved: it is listed in 'conflicts' and absent from 'modules'. Enterprise records carry only module facts (no paths, no file contents).

sources.description: Declared sources, sorted by source_id, unique.

modules.description: Module name -> record described by $defs.module. Sorted by name. Conflicted and unparsed modules are not present here.

conflicts.description: Modules declared by two or more sources. Sorted by module; each sources list is sorted and has at least two entries.

unparsed.description: Manifests that could not be read as a literal dict. Records carry the closed parse error code only; sorted by (module, source_id).

digest.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of every other key.

part.description: One source's module facts, as built by build_part. Recognised module roots only: <m>/__manifest__.py at repo root, addons/<m>/__manifest__.py, odoo/addons/<m>/__manifest__.py. Deeper manifests are ignored and counted in skipped_nested. Module records are checked in code.

modules.description: Module name -> record with depends, installable, auto_install, manifest_digest, path_digest and optional parse_error.

skipped.description: Root-level manifests and module roots whose directory name fails the name rule.

skipped_nested.description: Manifests deeper than the three recognised module roots.

parse_errors.description: Sorted names of modules whose record carries parse_error.

module.description: Record for one resolved module. Exactly these keys; a module record never carries paths or file contents.

auto_install.description: A literal list in the manifest maps to true when non-empty.
